messages:
Pranav: Quick intake — planning a windowed-batching + ctx-length sweep for gale-11b (community fork). Need baseline throughput/latency before any quant. Who can own a 1st pass today? @Marta :raised_hands:
Marta: I can run a sweep this afternoon. what configs do you want prioritized? small batches with high ctx, or larger batches short ctx?
Pranav: Prioritize worst-case tail first: ctxs=512,1024,2048,4096. batch sizes 1,2,4,8,16. Also try windowed-batching on/off to measure gains. Target metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec.
Jing: Add cold-start/cached scenarios — 0 KV warmed vs 1 warm request per worker. p99 is sensitive to cold starts.
Sam: For warmups, I'd do 100 warmup steps then 500 measurement steps. Also log per-token time and memcpy spikes.
Marta: Ack. I'll run two job types: (A) single-worker microbench to capture latency distribution, (B) multi-worker throughput (16 workers) to see batching behavior. ETA 4h.
Pranav: Perfect. CI job names: gale11b.ctx-sweep.windowed-Y and gale11b.ctx-sweep.windowed-N. Please attach perf-ci run links when done.
perf-ci-bot: Scheduled benchmark: gale11b.ctx-sweep.windowed-Y (job 8347) — queued on perf pool.
Sam: Quick command I used earlier (paste into bench env):
```bash
./perf_bench --model gale-11b \
  --quant none \
  --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8,16 \
  --contexts 512,1024,2048,4096 \
  --windowed-batching true \
  --warmup 100 --steps 500 \
  --workers 1 \
  --log-json ./out/gale11b_windowed_Y.json
```
Marta: Running with that now but I'll also do `--workers 16` for the throughput sweep and change `--windowed-batching false` variant.
Pranav: When you post results, include: median token/sec, p99 latency at each ctx, and a short note if memory bumps lead to GC/oob errors. Also flag any >10% regression vs our reference (odyssey11b-smoke) tail numbers.
Jing: For post-checklist: after baseline, schedule quant smoke: int8 dynamic then int4 quant (per-channel) and compare quality with our eval set (50 prompts). If quality drop >2% (BLEU/Exact-match proxy) we hold.
Marta: Noted. I'll attach both perf jsons + a quick summary table to the thread.
Pranav: Ownership: Marta = perf runs & artifacts, Sam = warmup config + infra tweaks, Jing = regression gating for quality. I'll open a small GH issue linking the artifacts + decision rubric.
Marta: first batch started (job 8347), will ping when multi-worker run completes. :rocket:
Pranav: Thanks — ping me if anything flakes or memory spikes.
perf-ci-bot: Job 8347 started on node perf-12. Logs: http://ci.internal/perf/8347
Marta: Update 30m — single-worker latency sweep done. Early observation: windowed-batching reduces p99 by ~18% at ctx=2048, tokens/sec up ~25% for batch>=4. Uploading out/gale11b_windowed_Y.json now.
Pranav: Great findings. Once multi-worker run finishes, we'll draft checklist for promote-to-dedicated: (1) baseline perf, (2) quant smoke, (3) eval quality, (4) memory/correctness pass.
Marta: Multi-worker done. Uploads: out/gale11b_windowed_Y_multi.json, out/gale11b_windowed_N_multi.json. Summary in the files.
Pranav: Next steps: Jing to run eval set against int8/int4 variants, Sam to run longer 10k-step throughput soak overnight. We'll reconvene tomorrow morning for decision. :calendar:
